rule.positive: The board advert is the same vacancy as the feed job: near-verbatim advert text (5-shingle containment >= 0.5 on the full board page) under Gaia Talent, or, hand-read, the same role title (formatting or a non-discipline qualifier aside) for the same client offices with the advert rewritten.
rule.negative: A different role, seniority or specialism; the same generic title for a different client or office set; or a board advert by another employer (Gaia's jobs are posted under 'Gaia Talent'; no other-employer advert carried a Gaia text).
rule.unsure: Excluded from scoring: same title family and the same client offices, but the title adds/removes a discipline or the client differs; could be a second vacancy
rule.selection: every feed x board pair with title similarity >= 0.3 or text containment >= 0.2 (hard pairs), all positives and unsure, plus 300 random easy negatives (seed 20261120) from the remaining 83 x 230 pairs.
